content: Virality score presentation convention: Opus Clip shows a per-clip virality score from predicted engagement (hook strength, pacing, topic signals) - the most-cited feature in creator reviews; Klap shows a per-clip virality score; Vizard ranks detected moments. The industry convention is a numeric 0-100 score, a short AI reason, and sorting clips by score descending - exactly matching the spec (viralityScore double 0-100, explanationReason, ORDER BY viralityScore DESC, Excellent/Moyen label threshold 75).
